<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Dwarven Lore](/Feats.aspx?ID=1) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Dwarf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=54" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 36

</column>

---

You eagerly absorbed the old stories and traditions of your ancestors, your gods, and your people, studying in subjects and techniques passed down for generation upon generation. You gain the trained proficiency rank in [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) and [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13). If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also become trained in [Dwarven Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8).
_source.name: Dwarven Lore

_source.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Dwarven Weapon Familiarity](/Feats.aspx?ID=2) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Dwarf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=54" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 36

</column>

---

Your kin have instilled in you an affinity for hard-hitting weapons, and you prefer these to more elegant arms. You are trained with the [battle axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=16), [pick](/Weapons.aspx?ID=34), and [warhammer](/Weapons.aspx?ID=47).

 You also gain access to all uncommon [dwarf](/Traits.aspx?ID=54) weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial dwarf weapons are simple weapons and advanced dwarf weapons are martial weapons.

<title level="2">Dwarven Weapon Familiarity leads to...</title>
[Dwarven Weapon Cunning](/Feats.aspx?ID=8), [Dwarven Weapon Expertise](/Feats.aspx?ID=11)
_source.name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity
